title: Register Roles
label: LAZADA · DEVELOPER GUIDE
subtitle: Last modified 2026-06-23 10:28:22
html:
After completing your Open Platform account registration, you will also need to register a role. This role registration will determine which modules and related features you will be able to use in the future.

Registration Role Map

Software Developer

If you need to integrate the Lazada Open API to query or update information in your store, please register for this role.

Intended Users: Those who need to call the Lazada Open API.

Please fill out the information on the registration page field by field and click “Completed” to submit. This information will not be made public.

Note：The logo must be exactly 200×200 px..

Service Provider

If you are not a seller but a provider of third-party SaaS software or third-party services and wish to sell your services to Lazada sellers, please register for this role.

User Type: Third-Party Service Provider

Note:Once you register this role, the action is irreversible, and you will not be able to change the partner type. Please choose carefully.

Name of the service provider

Your company name or the name of the service you offer to the public. It will be displayed in the “Enterprise Information” section of the Lazada Service Marketplace once your service is published.

Corporate logo

Your company logo or the logo used for public display. It will be displayed in the “Enterprise Information” section of the Lazada Service Marketplace after your service is published.

Note：The logo image must be exactly 200 × 200 px.

Introduction

An overview of your company.

Service countries

Your company's service coverage determines which country-specific marketplaces your service will be available in. If your service is available to Lazada sellers in all countries, please select all options.

Collection account No.

Since the Lazada Services Marketplace allows the listing of paid SKUs, please link your bank card before publishing your service in the corresponding country (excluding users from China and other regions).

Number of LAZADA clients

The number of Lazada sellers currently under contract with or using your company or service; this information is not publicly disclosed.
